test_only_binding.test_name: retarget lifecycle: Wayfinder is original and Knight is test-only corpus mapping
test_only_binding.selector_basis: The existing test explicitly selects the normalized comparison record by key=knight and asserts the full Wayfinder comparator; raw source joins below begin from that explicit selector. Binding is not inferred from branding-name or numeric-ID equality/inequality.

troop_summon_character.interpretation: The non-null name resolves to the same character row. It is retained as a raw relationship; no unit-count or spawning semantics are inferred from summon_number or other zero/sentinel fields.

projectile.result: No projectile row is linked by the selected troop/character projectile fields because both raw values are null.

buff.result: No non-null string buff-name link was present in the selected rows.

troop.rule: key name contains one of: ability, area_object, buff, character, clone, death, effect, export_name, filter, mesh, projectile, resurrect, spawn, summon, swf
troop.limit: A field-name screen is a bounded index, not proof of an exhaustive engine schema or field semantics.

character.rule: key name contains one of: ability, area_object, buff, character, clone, death, effect, export_name, filter, mesh, projectile, resurrect, spawn, summon, swf
character.limit: A field-name screen is a bounded index, not proof of an exhaustive engine schema or field semantics.
